brief.question: Is any useful hardware speedup possible if online routing decisions are removed, keeping physical copies and expert compute?
brief.healthy: Each online and replay output must match its same-policy causal full-resident reference. One shared expert pool at 3.99GiB, including first-visit retention and scratch. Compare replay candidates with replay static, not with online static.
brief.noise: Replay uses recorded routing decisions and is not an online method or an achievable deployment speedup. Full-resident tape recording times are not benchmark numbers. No compensation training or new quality tuning occurs.
brief.worth_a_flag: Tape mismatch, token mismatch, foreign GPU process or budget overflow. There are 96 timed requests total and 24 recording requests.
brief.from_parent: Parent live Load Once was 188.98ms/token vs exact static 151.05ms/token on Ouro. This is one bounded controller-overhead ceiling check before stopping or optimizing.
brief.decided: Stop this scheduling line if removing the controller still gives less than 5 percent useful matched-static headroom, or no meaningful incremental value over hot-only.
